name: Python
conventions:
Tests use the standard library `unittest` only (no pytest). The code under test is `solution.py` (plus extra modules if needed) inside starter/, solution/ and every bugs/<name>/. Each test file starts with:

    import os, sys
    sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", os.environ.get("TARGET", "starter")))
    from solution import <names>

Name tests descriptively (`test_last_run_is_kept`): the name is what `bugs[].expect` matches. Use `self.assertEqual(got, want, msg)` with a teaching msg. Type hints on public functions. A starter stub raises `NotImplementedError` or returns a wrong placeholder. Favor idiomatic Python: comprehensions, itertools/collections, generators, dataclasses, exceptions for errors.

levelNotes.5: Good depth topics: generators/iterators protocol, context managers, dataclasses with invariants, functools caching, descriptors.
levelNotes.7: Good depth topics: asyncio ordering and cancellation, heapq/bisect-based structures, memory via __slots__, typing.Protocol.
levelNotes.8: Good depth topics: small interpreters, metaclass-free plugin systems, persistent structures, asyncio schedulers.
